name: @projexlight/sdk-search
summary: Cross-SDK search for ProjexCloud: declare indexes per entity kind (contact, content item, ticket, file), the indexer fans out from source-of-truth events, and queries return tenant-scoped + permission-filtered hits. Hybrid BM25 + vector reranking when sdk-knowledge-rag is composed in; pure lexical otherwise.

endpoints.description: Run a query (q + index_filter); returns ranked hits with permission filtering.
Run a query with a body payload (for long queries / complex filters).
Declare or update an index definition (entity kind + field map + partitioning).
Save a named query for later (dashboards, alerts).
Trigger a reindex of a specific index + partition.
Whether a search backend is wired in this deployment. Lets a caller distinguish 'search unavailable' from 'no matches'. Returns 200 even when unavailable — read data.search_up, not the status.

events.name: search.index.declared.v1
events.description: New index definition or schema-change applied.

events.name: search.partition.reindexed.v1
events.description: Per-partition reindex finished; carries doc count + elapsed.

events.name: search.query.executed.v1
events.description: Query executed; audited for usage + cost attribution.

events.name: search.saved_query.fired.v1
events.description: Saved-query refresh result diverged from last run; powers alerts.

models.description: Per-index row: name, entity_kind, field_map, refresh_cadence.
Per-(index, partition) row: shard, doc_count, last_indexed_at.
Named query: q, filters, owner_persona, refresh_cadence.

hooks.name: declareIndex
hooks.description: Create / update an index definition. Migrations applied async.

hooks.name: query
hooks.description: Execute a search query. Permission filtering via sdk-rebac.

hooks.name: saveQuery
hooks.description: Persist a named query for re-execution / alerting.

hooks.name: reindexPartition
hooks.description: Force a reindex of one partition (after schema change / data correction).

hooks.name: startIndexerWorker
hooks.description: Background worker that fans out from source events into the index.

scenarios.title: Declare a contacts index with fuzzy-name + company fields
scenarios.when_to_use: Sales team needs quick contact search by name / company / email. Declare once; indexer fans out from crm.contact.created.v1 + .updated.v1 to keep it fresh.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Index definition persisted; emits .index.declared.v1. Indexer worker backfills + then subscribes to source events.

scenarios.title: AE searches contacts; results filtered by their territory
scenarios.when_to_use: AE issues 'company:acme'; we filter by their territory via sdk-rebac so they don't see contacts outside their book.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Permission-filtered ranked hits returned. .query.executed.v1 audited for usage + cost. Out-of-territory matches silently dropped.

scenarios.title: Save a query with a daily-refresh alert
scenarios.when_to_use: Sales-ops wants daily 'enterprise deals stalled > 30d'; saved query refreshes nightly + alerts when the set diverges from last run.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Saved query stored. Daily refresh; .saved_query.fired.v1 emitted on diff. sdk-notification routes to the owner.

scenarios.title: Reindex after adding a new field to the index definition
scenarios.when_to_use: Schema change: added a 'persona_segment' field; reindex to populate it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Reindex job queued; partition rebuilt. Emits .partition.reindexed.v1 with doc count + elapsed.

scenarios.title: Hybrid lexical + vector with sdk-knowledge-rag composed
scenarios.when_to_use: Composed deployment — sdk-knowledge-rag provides vector reranking on top of the BM25 lexical pass for natural-language queries.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Hybrid pass: lexical BM25 narrows; vector rerank surfaces the most relevant. Falls back to lexical-only when sdk-knowledge-rag isn't installed.

compliance_posture.notes: Permission filtering via sdk-rebac is mandatory on every query — index can't leak across territories / BU bounds. Erasure events propagate to the index (search rows removed within minutes). Partition_by region pin satisfies residency.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per saved-query refresh that emits an alert
